name: Can I assess my roof for water damage myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I assess my roof for water damage myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While you can visually check your ceilings for stains or your attic for obvious leaks, a professional assessment is highly recommended for accurate identification of water damage. Professionals have the training and equipment to safely inspect hard-to-reach areas, identify hidden damage, and determine the root cause, which often isn't obvious from a ground-level view. Attempting a DIY assessment without proper safety measures can also be dangerous.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can check for obvious signs, but professionals are recommended for accurate, safe, and comprehensive water damage assessments.
